title: Claude using my personal account rather than my organization account (same email)
body:
Duplicate / re-opening of #199 

The suggested solution is to select "Switch account" and/or "Switch organization".

My account only has the "Switch Account" button. I tap it, log in using my email (same email for both), but it won't let me choose a new organization, and plops me back to a page reading "Claude Code would like to connect to your Anthropic organization Tony's Individual Organization".

I can't delete my personal (trial) account without support's help either, so I'm stuck.
author: TonyD-TuftAndPaw
